Change c0475. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. VII; 1831 Ch. XXIV.

Context before (unchanged): My present situation was one in which all voluntary thought was swallowed up and lost.

1818 text: I was hurried away by fury; revenge alone endowed me with strength and composure; it modelled my feelings, and allowed me to be calculating and calm, at periods when otherwise delirium or death would have been my portion.

1831 text: I was hurried away by fury; revenge alone endowed me with strength and composure; it moulded my feelings, and allowed me to be calculating and calm, at periods when otherwise delirium or death would have been my portion.

Diff: I was hurried away by fury; revenge alone endowed me with strength and composure; it [-modelled-] {+moulded+} my feelings, and allowed me to be calculating and calm, at periods when otherwise delirium or death would have been my portion.

Context after (unchanged): My first resolution was to quit Geneva for ever; my country, which, when I was happy and beloved, was dear to me, now, in my adversity, became hateful.

result.rationale: 'modelled' becomes 'moulded': a word-choice swap keeping the sense of shaping or forming the feelings; the change is also orthographic (modelled/moulded spelling conventions), with no shift in meaning.
